SikaBond® PVA is a cross linked waterbased adhesive suitable for interior and exterior applications. It is an ideal adhesive for bonding a wide range of timber components including tongue and groove, solid timber, laminated flooring and most porous substrates. SikaBond® PVA forms a tough permanent bond and makes it ideal for use by trades, carpenters and DIY.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Storage conditions
cl.x: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions and out of direct sunlight at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C. Always refer to packaging. Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage.

Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 01.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
cl.x: For optimum adhesion the substrates must be clean, dry, sound and free from oils, grease, dust, loose or friable particles.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools
cl.x: SikaBond® PVA is supplied ready to use and applied by squeeze bottle, brush or roller. Bonds should be assembled within a few minutes and then tightly clamped or pressed until the adhesive has set. Wipe off any excess adhesive immediately after assembly with a dry or lightly damp cloth. Assemblies must be allowed to cure for a minimum of 24 hours prior to moving or transportation. Maximum bond strength is achieved within 48 hours. Allow floors 24 hours for the adhesive to cure prior to use.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically. For cleaning skin use detergent and water.

s: Do not use the SikaBond® PVA in applications under water pressure or permanent water immersion.
